subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.
Something that has the quality of being easily broken
solution:
The correct answer is: **Brittle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"brittle"** means something that is easily broken, cracked, or snapped. (नाज़ुक)

 
 
• **Example: **The brittle glass shattered into pieces when it fell off the table.
 
 
 
• **"Broken"** refers to something that has been fractured or damaged and is no longer in one piece or in working order. (टूटा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The broken vase lay in shards on the floor.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word **'brittle'** correctly describes something that has the quality of being easily broken.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Brittle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Broken** (टूटा हुआ): Something that is fractured or damaged.

 
 
• **Example:** The broken chair was unable to support anyone's weight.
 
 
 
• **Damage** (क्षति): Harm or injury that makes something less valuable or useful.
 
 
• **Example:** The storm caused extensive damage to the buildings.
 
 
 
• **Hard** (कठिन): Something that is solid, firm, and resistant to pressure; not easily broken.
 
 
• **Example:** The hard rock was difficult to break with a hammer.
